actions.ask_localai.props.frequencyPenal: From -2 to 2. Higher repeats lines less. Defaults to 0.
actions.ask_localai.props.maxTokens.desc: Longest answer to generate, in tokens. Defaults to 2048.
actions.ask_localai.props.model.descript: The chat model on your LocalAI server that will write the answer.
actions.ask_localai.props.presencePenalt: From -2 to 2. Higher moves to new topics. Defaults to 0.6.
actions.ask_localai.props.roles.descript: Messages sent before the question, each with a role and content.
actions.ask_localai.props.temperature.de: Higher is more random, lower is more focused. Defaults to 0.9.
actions.ask_localai.props.topP.descripti: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1.
actions.create_embedding.description: Turn text into a vector for semantic search or clustering.
actions.create_embedding.props.input.des: The text to turn into a vector.
actions.create_embedding.props.model.des: An embedding model installed on your LocalAI server.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.list_models.description: List the models installed on your LocalAI server.
actions.list_models.props.contains.descr: Only return models whose id includes this text.
actions.text_to_speech.description: Turn text into a spoken audio file.
actions.text_to_speech.props.fileName.de: Name for the audio file, without the extension.
actions.text_to_speech.props.format.desc: Not every LocalAI backend supports every format.
actions.text_to_speech.props.model.descr: A text-to-speech model installed on your LocalAI server.
actions.text_to_speech.props.voice.descr: For models with several voices. Empty uses the default.
actions.transcribe_audio.description: Turn speech in an audio file into text.
Language code of the speech. Empty auto-detects.
actions.transcribe_audio.props.model.des: A speech-recognition model (for example whisper) installed on your LocalAI server.
auth.props.access_token.description: One of the API keys your server was started with (--api-keys or API_KEY). Leave empty if the server has no keys.
auth.props.base_url.description: The address of your LocalAI server, for example http://localhost:8080/v1. It must be reachable from Activepieces.
description: The free, Self-hosted, community-driven and local-first. Drop-in replacement for OpenAI running on consumer-grade hardware. No GPU required.
